note: PR 1, the cover rule (issue #192; also closes #242 and folds in items 1 and 4 of #290). Built from the design's sketches of lib/main-tool.sh, carry.sh and the bot-review.sh lines. Differences: bot-review.sh asks carry from the newest review with a body (the commit Snapshot.botAt names), not from the paused summary's commit; main_tool ensure waits up to 1800 s for the shared lock and retries a lost git fetch ref lock twice; carry.sh names an exit of 124 or 137 as a timeout. main-tool.test.sh 66 cases, carry.test.sh 88, bot-review.test.sh 75 (the 46 old cases keep their text), sourced-bash.test.sh and gh-api-rest.test.sh pass, shellcheck 0.11.0 -x clean on every changed script. Mutants: carry from the summary's commit fails 3 bot-review cases; ensure waiting 1 s fails 2 main-tool cases; dropping state=reviewed fails 9; dropping the head guard fails 2. A real cold build of main's tool through carry.sh took 12.5 min on a loaded machine. Real runs: carry.sh 301 covers 3bcdcb9 from 8d12734; bot-review.sh reads reviewed (carried from ...) on #257, #264, #287 and #291, where main's script read paused or behind. PR 1 does not touch #290 items 2, 3, 5 and 6.
